verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe Split Inbox, which divides the inbox into areas of focus with user-designed categories such as "VIP", "Notifications", "Calendar" and "Team". AI Auto Labels classify mail on arrival, separate marketing and social updates, and can drive custom split tabs so similar emails are handled together. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of split-inbox triage; custom AI Auto Labels are limited to Business/Enterprise plans; explicit ordering of streams by priority is only implied.
